spelling_description: Dictations with words English spells two ways, as speech-to-text writes them (American: Parakeet's and Whisper's training text is mostly US English). With --locale en-GB the cleanup should write them the British way ("Use my region's spelling", about_you.rs); with en-US, or no locale, the American way. Run --cleanup-rounds times each, after the latency phases.
